proposal.label: needs more info
proposal.comment: Could you provide the build/link details and target architecture so we can reproduce this? Specifically, please share whether you used a prebuilt `duckdb.dll` or built it from source, the exact compiler and toolchain (e.g. MSVC version), whether your program and the DLL are x86 or x86_64, and the compile/link commands or a minimal project (e.g. a small Visual Studio project or CMakeLists) that reproduces the crash. Also say if you ran a Debug or Release build and whether you mixed CRT (debug vs release) between your app and the DLL.
proposal.rationale: The report includes a short C++ snippet and OS/version, but lacks essential build and linking details (prebuilt vs built-from-source DLL, compiler/toolchain, target architecture, build type, and compile/link commands). These environment details are required to reproduce an access-violation caused by ABI/CRT or architecture mismatches.
